objective: Three-grade apple appearance at roughly 20 FPS for a 1280-long-edge scene with maturity, lesions, per-instance grading and rendering.
denominators: Fixed AF 110 regression, grades 56/37/17. Keep missing/multiple fruit boxes as unresolved; never assume a single apple in scene mode. Full fruit image is secondary. HDF is a retrospective source-fresh/source-rot stress panel of 69/200.

field_gates.timing: 20 predecoded photos, 5 warmups and 30 rounds for 600 frames per mode. Report mean, P95 and FPS, including rendering. Separately time the resize from 4K and record CPU thread count. Nominal target 20, report exact deviation.

development_gate: Choose on training/development sources only. A challenger to enter field review must improve AF dev automatic mild over the frozen 320 model (at least 6/15), keep good >=20/25, severe-to-good=0/17, severe correct >=16/17, and whole severe-to-good=0. Rank by gate, automatic mild correct, fewer good/severe regressions, then held-out-within-development source checks. If a branch fails, report development evidence. Never change the above thresholds after a field look.
independence: All HDF, AF test, source-held FruitLife fruit IDs, earlier grocery and Commons panels are excluded from new fitting. Entire PLOS source reserved for possible blind external use, contingent on licensing, duplicate and label audits. Grade labels require original grade or explicitly identified visible-surface proxies. Report distinct physical units where known and per-source confusion, not a pooled percentage.
deployment: Preserve previous weight bytes and defaults. Per-image gains and regressions are mandatory even if class totals match. Do not promote a failed candidate.
